response.cue_rationale: The candidates fit the physical document-marking sense, while the unmodified cue also permits the figurative sense of automatic approval.

response.rationale: “Cap” is the ordinary Indonesian term and “cop” the ordinary Malaysian term for a physical stamp used on documents. The contrast is useful and fits the same literal sense after narrowing the cue.
response.risk_rationale: Indonesian also commonly uses “stempel” for this object, so the national preference may be context-dependent.
